runs.t: At EFG Holding, stakeholder engagement is guided by transparency, accountability, and continuous dialogue. We recognize that long-term value creation depends on understanding the expectations and concerns of those who interact with our business across EFG Holding and its subsidiaries. Our approach emphasizes structured engagement channels, consistent communication, and clear feedback loops that inform strategy, risk management, and operational decisions.

Engagement is embedded across functions and business lines, ensuring that awareness campaigns, educational initiatives, peer collaboration, and community-building activities are not standalone efforts but part of an integrated framework. By maintaining open dialogue and measuring outcomes, we strengthen trust, anticipate emerging risks, and ensure our ESG priorities remain responsive and relevant.
Targeted communications across EFG Holding and subsidiaries
Impact: Strengthens transparency and informed participation.
Equipping stakeholders with knowledge and tools
Impact: Enhances capability, resilience, and long-term value creation.
Impact: Encourages shared standards and market development.
Impact: Deepens trust and supports inclusive growth.
